sections.topic: Indian Rainfall Zones and Monsoon Patterns
sections.where: Rocket Sheets · Indian Geography › #16 · Indian Rainfall Zones and Monsoon Patterns
bullets: The very heavy rainfall zone includes the Western Coast and Northeast India.
The scanty rainfall zone includes Western Rajasthan, Gujarat, Punjab, Haryana, and the rain-shadow Deccan.
The Arabian Sea branch of the Southwest Monsoon causes heavy rainfall on the Western Coast.
Kerala is a key region of heavy rainfall on the Western Coast.
The Tamil Nadu coast receives rainfall from the Northeast or retreating monsoon.
